name: Logan State Park
evidence: ReserveAmerica per-site 'Proximity to Water: Shore' on RV sites A013-A015, A017 (30-45 ft back-ins; B001-B004 only 'Water View'); FWP logan-2024.pdf puts A17 by the boat slips; satellite at 48.0332,-115.0697: west-loop pads ~40-50 m from Middle Thompson Lake across open unused wet meadow (day-use lawn is east of the slips)

name: Rocky Mountain Hi RV Park & Campground
evidence: operator site map (site_map_hi.png): Spring Creek on the W/S edge, RV rows 90-99 behind the park road, power/water sites A-H behind a tree strip, swim hole/dock is day-use; satellite at 48.2530,-114.2520: creek under canopy ~35 m from RVs with the gravel road between

name: West Shore Unit - Flathead Lake State Park
evidence: ReserveAmerica per-site 'Proximity to Water: Water View' on all 12 RV sites B001-B012 (only B014, tent-only hike-in, is 'Lakefront'); FWP trail map + satellite at 47.9520,-114.1855: Loop B ~120-200 m upslope of Flathead Lake in open conifer, canopy-blind at pad level

name: Yellowstone Park / Mountainside KOA Journey
evidence: satellite at 44.6884,-111.2515: Denny Creek runs in a willow hedge ~30 m N of the top row with the loop road and a bare strip between, creek screened; willow carr NW behind conifers; KOA 'near the creek' is prose (creekside sites it names are tent sites)

name: Riverfront RV Park
evidence: operator NewSiteMap.pdf: Little Blackfoot River on the park's SE side, every RV row's river end (26, 51) behind the loop road with the chapel lawn beyond; satellite at 46.5188,-112.7940: river ~40-50 m from the nearest spurs across the road and a cottonwood belt on the bank

name: River Edge Resort RV Park
evidence: operator RV and camping map (map-1.jpg): tent sites 1-5 hold the Clark Fork bank, RV sites 1-14 behind the gravel through-road; satellite at 47.0032,-114.4907: RVs ~35-40 m from the water across the road, tent strip and gappy riparian brush; river visible

name: Big Beaver Campground
evidence: satellite at 45.4641,-110.1988 (FS-listed coord; old pin was on the road ~90 m NE): trailer pad ~20 m from the Main Boulder River's east bank, more spurs along the bank under trees; FS 'Blakely Creek' wording is wrong, the camp is on the Boulder

name: Eagle Creek Campground
evidence: rec.gov 10134047 site coords plotted on satellite at 45.0456,-110.6795: loops on a sagebrush bench beside Eagle Creek's aspen/willow thicket, channel not visible, no per-site water flags; Yellowstone River not within 1 km (FS 'along the Yellowstone' is generic); old pin at the entrance junction
